description: This file defines the WriteSyncer interface and its implementations, including synchronization, locking, multi-writer, and wrapper functionalities for buffered writing and flushing in the zapcore logging library.

classes.name: lockedWriteSyncer
classes.description: A thread-safe wrapper around a WriteSyncer that uses a mutex to ensure safe concurrent access.

classes.name: writerWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around io.Writer that provides a no-op Sync method.

classes.name: multiWriteSyncer
classes.description: A composite WriteSyncer that duplicates writes and sync calls across multiple underlying WriteSyncers.

methods.name: AddSync
methods.description: Converts an io.Writer to a WriteSyncer, adding a no-op Sync if necessary.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Wraps a WriteSyncer in a mutex to make it safe for concurrent use.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data to the underlying WriteSyncer, with synchronization.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Flushes buffered data by calling Sync on the underlying WriteSyncer, with synchronization.

methods.name: NewMultiWriteSyncer
methods.description: Creates a WriteSyncer that duplicates writes and sync calls across multiple WriteSyncers.
